title: Budget Justification Generator — UDM Output
description: JSON contract for a generated budget-justification narrative produced from a grant budget form and a project narrative (and optionally a NOFO / RFA). The output captures both the structured per-section extracted financial data and the generated narrative text for each section, plus the final assembled Markdown document and cross-validation notes. Organized in R&R Budget / SF-424A category order (A-I). Mirrors the source ui-insight/ProcessMapping budget-justification-generator workflow's four parallel extraction-and-generation tasks plus a Consolidation Prompt.

project_title.description: Project title from the proposal. Required by source workflow. Resolves to UDM Proposal.Proposal_Title.

pi_name.description: Principal Investigator name. Required by source workflow. Resolves to UDM Personnel.Last_Name.

sponsoring_agency.description: Sponsoring agency name when determinable. Resolves to UDM Organization.Organization_Name.

budget_period_count.description: Number of budget periods (1 for single-year, N for multi-year). Required by source workflow.

is_multi_year_budget.description: Whether the budget spans multiple years.

personnel_and_fringe.description: Sections A (Senior/Key Personnel), B (Other Personnel), C (Fringe Benefits).

senior_key_personnel.description: Senior / Key Personnel table. Required by source workflow. Resolves to UDM Personnel.

other_personnel.description: Other Personnel table. Empty array when no other personnel are listed in the budget.

total_senior_personnel_cost.description: Total salary costs for all senior / key personnel. Required by source workflow. JSON number. Resolves to UDM ProposalBudget.Direct_Cost.

total_other_personnel_cost.description: Total salary costs for all other personnel. JSON number.

fringe_benefit_rates.description: Fringe benefit rates by personnel category with calculation basis. Required by source workflow.

total_fringe_benefits.description: Total fringe benefit costs. Required by source workflow. JSON number. Resolves to UDM ProposalBudget.Direct_Cost.

is_salary_cap_applicable.description: Whether any personnel salary is subject to an agency salary cap.

salary_cap_amount.description: Agency salary cap amount when applicable. JSON number.

year_over_year_personnel_changes.description: Description of personnel effort or salary changes across budget years. Null for single-year budgets.

section_a_narrative.description: Generated professional justification text for Section A (Senior/Key Personnel).

section_b_narrative.description: Generated professional justification text for Section B (Other Personnel). Use 'No other personnel costs are requested for this project.' when other_personnel is empty.

section_c_narrative.description: Generated professional justification text for Section C (Fringe Benefits).

equipment_items.description: Each equipment item with name, cost, and purpose. Empty array when no equipment is requested.

total_equipment_cost.description: Total equipment costs. JSON number. Resolves to UDM ProposalBudget.Direct_Cost.

equipment_threshold_applied.description: Equipment cost threshold (e.g., 'Standard $5,000 threshold per institutional policy', '$10,000 threshold per 2 CFR 200.313'). Null when defaulted.

domestic_travel.description: Domestic trips. Empty array when no domestic travel is requested.

foreign_travel.description: Foreign trips. Empty array when no foreign travel is requested.

total_domestic_travel_cost.description: Total domestic travel costs. JSON number. Resolves to UDM ProposalBudget.Direct_Cost.

total_foreign_travel_cost.description: Total foreign travel costs. JSON number. Resolves to UDM ProposalBudget.Direct_Cost.

is_foreign_travel_restricted.description: Whether the NOFO restricts foreign travel.

travel_cost_basis.description: Basis for travel cost estimates (GSA rates, quotes, etc.).

section_d_narrative.description: Generated professional justification text for Section D (Equipment). Use 'No equipment costs are requested for this project.' when equipment_items is empty.

section_e_domestic_narrative.description: Generated professional justification text for Section E — Domestic Travel.

section_e_foreign_narrative.description: Generated professional justification text for Section E — Foreign Travel.

participant_support_and_other_direct_cos.description: Sections F (Participant Support) and G (Other Direct Costs, subcategories G.1-G.9).

participant_support_costs.description: Participant support cost breakdown (stipends, travel, subsistence, other). Empty array when none.

total_participant_support.description: Total participant / trainee support costs. JSON number. Resolves to UDM ProposalBudget.Direct_Cost.

materials_and_supplies.description: Materials and supplies with categories and costs. Empty array when none.

publication_costs.description: Publication and documentation costs. JSON number. Resolves to UDM ProposalBudget.Direct_Cost.

consultant_services.description: Each consultant with name/TBD, rate, days, total, and scope. Empty array when no consultants.

subaward_details.description: Each subaward with institution, PI, scope, and total cost. Empty array when no subawards.

total_subaward_costs.description: Total subaward / subcontract costs. JSON number. Resolves to UDM ProposalBudget.Direct_Cost.

tuition_remission.description: Graduate student tuition remission costs. JSON number. Resolves to UDM ProposalBudget.Direct_Cost.

other_direct_costs.description: Other direct costs not fitting above categories. Empty array when none.

total_other_direct_costs.description: Total of all Other Direct Cost subcategories. JSON number. Resolves to UDM ProposalBudget.Direct_Cost.

section_f_narrative.description: Generated professional justification text for Section F (Participant Support). Use 'No participant / trainee support costs are requested for this project.' when total_participant_support is 0.

section_g_narrative.description: Generated professional justification text for Section G (Other Direct Costs) — assembles G.1-G.9 subsections in order.

indirect_costs_and_summary.description: Section H (Indirect Costs / F&A), Cost Sharing, and Budget Summary.

fa_rate_percentage.description: F&A (indirect cost) rate as a percentage (e.g., 56.5 for 56.5%). Required by source workflow. JSON number. Resolves to UDM IndirectRate.Rate_Percentage.

fa_base_type.description: F&A rate base type (MTDC, TDC, Salaries and Wages, etc.). Required by source workflow. Resolves to UDM IndirectRate.Base_Type.

fa_rate_type.description: Type of F&A rate (on-campus, off-campus, etc.). Defaults to 'Federally negotiated rate' when not stated. Resolves to UDM IndirectRate.Rate_Type.

mtdc_base_exclusions.description: Items excluded from the MTDC base (equipment, participant support, subaward amounts over $25,000, tuition, capital expenditures). Empty array defaults to standard MTDC exclusions.

is_fa_rate_capped.description: Whether the NOFO imposes a cap on the F&A rate.

fa_rate_cap_details.description: Details of any F&A rate cap from the NOFO.

total_direct_costs.description: Total direct costs across all budget categories. Required by source workflow. JSON number. Resolves to UDM ProposalBudget.Direct_Cost.

total_indirect_costs.description: Total indirect (F&A) costs. Required by source workflow. JSON number. Resolves to UDM ProposalBudget.Indirect_Cost.

total_project_costs.description: Total project costs (direct + indirect). Required by source workflow. JSON number.

cost_share_required.description: Whether cost sharing or matching is required. Resolves to UDM CostShare.Is_Mandatory.

cost_share_amount.description: Total cost-share commitment amount. JSON number. Resolves to UDM CostShare.Committed_Amount.

cost_share_type.description: Type of cost share (cash, in-kind, third-party, waived IDC). Resolves to UDM CostShare.Commitment_Type.

cost_share_sources.description: Sources of cost-share contributions. Empty array when none specified.

budget_period_summary.description: Year-by-year budget summary table for multi-year budgets. Empty array for single-period budgets. Resolves to UDM ProposalBudget.Period_Number.

year_over_year_variations.description: Explanation of year-over-year budget changes. Null for single-year budgets.

nofo_budget_rules.description: Agency-specific budget rules or restrictions from the NOFO. Empty array when no NOFO provided or no specific rules identified.

nofo_page_limit_for_justification.description: Page limit for the budget justification from the NOFO.

section_h_narrative.description: Generated professional justification text for Section H (Indirect Costs). Show the MTDC calculation.

cost_share_narrative.description: Generated professional justification text for Cost Sharing. Use 'No cost sharing is required for this project and none is proposed.' when not required.

budget_summary_narrative.description: Generated budget summary overview with totals and year-over-year explanation.

cross_validation.description: Cross-validation notes for the RA's internal review only. NOT for submission to the sponsor.

items_requiring_clarification.description: Items where the budget or narrative used placeholder text or 'clarification needed from PI'. Empty array when none.

missing_justification_flags.description: Budget categories that show a dollar amount but lack narrative justification. Empty array when all categories have justification.

final_justification_document.description: The complete, assembled budget-justification narrative as a single Markdown string in R&R Budget / SF-424A category order (A through I) plus Cost Sharing and Budget Summary, with the Cross-Validation Notes section clearly marked as not-for-submission.
